purpose: Field registry for the Cell Type Inference Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen Cell Type Inference candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use the Layer 1 family label or a conservative shortened form after PubMed/DOI verification.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates probabilistic mixture, regression, topic-model, graph, alignment, reconstruction, and specialized state-detection routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameters or commands.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes scRNA-reference, marker-gene, image, spatial-coordinate, and reference-free routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Cell Type Inference.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only cell-type inference, deconvolution, cell placement, annotation, or state inference roles.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-task methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as cell-type proportions, abundance map, cell placement, annotation, or cell-state score.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes mixture deconvolution from cell-level reconstruction and specialized state calls.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the branch-local decision tree.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the frozen registry label when present; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a resource gate after scientific task fit.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Marks methods needing later engineering scrutiny without claiming execution support.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spot/cell counts, high-resolution maps, or atlas-scale references.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Treat labels as Layer 2 synthesis unless directly sourced.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps avoid starting with fragile or heavy routes for large slices.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with BioHarness runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when a primary code/documentation source is present in the frozen input or verified retrieval context.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes method-paper support from benchmark or review support.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on direct evidence and Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Mention verified PMID/DOI or retrieval gap; explicitly label comparator, risk, burden, or branch fit as Layer 2 synthesis when relevant.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence strength and uncertainty visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the conditional decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Reference Dependence
fields.definition: Whether the method depends on scRNA-seq reference data, marker genes, or no external cell-type reference.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use unclear where the frozen row and bounded retrieval do not resolve the dependency.
fields.topic_relevance: Reference dependence is the first major branch in cell-type inference.

fields.name: Spatial Signal Use
fields.definition: Whether spatial coordinates or spatial neighborhood structure are central to the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use none, optional, required, or unclear based on the method claim.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates generic deconvolution from spatially aware deconvolution and reconstruction.

fields.name: Image Signal Use
fields.definition: Whether histology, morphology, nuclei, or image-derived signal is central to the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use none, optional, required, or unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Identifies methods that should only be branch-local choices when image quality is suitable.

fields.name: Resolution Target
fields.definition: Primary resolution or biological target of inference.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents mixing spot-level proportion tools with cell-placement or state-specific tools.

fields.name: Benchmark Coverage
fields.definition: How the row was covered by bounded benchmark/review screening.
fields.fill_rule: Use independent benchmark includes when a benchmark paper covers the method; review-only coverage for review-screened rows; method-paper/local benchmark only for direct or recent method rows; verification gap when PubMed identity is unresolved.
fields.topic_relevance: Constrains evidence strength and tie-break logic.

fields.name: Selection-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Main scientific or benchmark-validity caveat for selecting the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise caveat; distinguish reference mismatch, image bias, rare-cell sensitivity, resolution mismatch, and evidence gaps.
fields.topic_relevance: Carries scientific critical-thinking cautions into the decision tree.
